text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The day of the Satsuki Sho.
Nakayama Racecourse Entrance.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: We've arrived on site, Boss.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Anyway, come to the Satsuki Sho! Even if you can't swim, just come!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Did Gold Ship approach with ill intent back then?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was it just to tease Fenomeno?
Or perhaps—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
What Golshi-san does is beyond the imagination
of ordinary people. However—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
――... No.
Searching for reason in Golshi-san's actions
is the most pointless thing one could do.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
She prioritizes having fun above all else.
That's why everyone around her...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, excuse me.
Let's head over to the stands, Boss."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Even if she isn't your goal,
the Satsuki Sho is the first leg of the Classic Triple Crown.
It is a crucial race for any Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "CASE: Profiling"

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"Uoooooh, you can do it!"
"It's your first step to becoming a Triple Crown Umamusume, give it your all!"
choice_data_list: So this is the Satsuki Sho paddock...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes. There are even more people than during the Hopeful Stakes...! And children too...

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Golshi's racing today!
I just love Golshi's races~♪

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...To watch an interesting run.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Next up is a huge favorite with the kids!
Gold Ship makes her entran————... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, Gold Ship-san isn't here!?
Wasn't she supposed to be in the back just now...!?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yooo, right here!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: It's Golshiii!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Marme-chin.
Took you long enough, bastard.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you...! Why are you here...!
If you're a runner, you should be in the paddock...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so stiff.
Look, there's a Golshi over there too. See?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: There's nobody here, though...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~~? Look with your mind's eye more!
See...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *gasp*...
See, Golshi-chan was there, wasn't she...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: G-Golshi-!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
H-Haaah!? That was just me
going all out, wasn't it...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
And on top of that, wasting energy before the race...
.................., ............urrrgh!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Even on a stage you only get to stand on once, you're fooling around...!!
choice_data_list: I went out of my way to come check if you were here...
I went out of my way to come check if you were here...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
choice_data_list: Let's just watch the race for now, Meno.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ……Understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the race began—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ora ora ora ora ora!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What a move by Gold Ship!
She hugs the inner rail on the fourth corner!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She surges straight into the battle for the lead!
This is a warp! It's the Golshi Warp at work!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Wh— That's completely absurd!!
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah. I can't believe it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Due to rain from the previous day,
the turf on today's course—especially on the inside—was in rough shape.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Normally, an Umamusume would run on the cleaner outside turf
to avoid wasting unnecessary stamina. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Going out of your way
to run along a path no other Umamusume would choose—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Who are you?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: What is your deal...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Hell yeah!
Thiiis is the one and only Golshi-chan!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Oooohh!
Golshi, congrats on 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, Golshi, you're amaziiing!
So hilariousss!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —...Damn it.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Ah. Broadcast booth, broadcast booth! We're here with the 1st place winner, Gold Ship—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice.
Lend it to me☆

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yo... Audience.
There's somethin' I gotta tell ya...

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, what's going on...?"
"What's wrong with Golshi...?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I wuv... evewyone...
Thas why...

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"Aww, I love Golshi too!!"
"Me too! Good luck, Golshi!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... Sorry...
Sorry, sooorry, that's not what I meant...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You have to... confess...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I am...
M, A, M, E, C, H,
et cetera spelling, remainder omitted...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I am... Fenomeno...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Gold Ship-san.
Could you please give the mic back...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh. I'll just leave this here for now!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ufu, I'm Mame-chin♪
Fenomeno, in the flesh!♡

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Later-☆

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, Golshi, you're so weird!"
"You're not Meno, you're Golshi!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: You must not use a false name!!??

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: You mustn't! I won't allow it! If that became children's greatest aspiration, then—!

text_block_list.name: Kid Who Admires Golshi
text_block_list.text:
"...Hello? Mom?
It's me. ...No, no! Olé!"

text_block_list.name: Kid Who Admires Golshi
text_block_list.text:
It's me, Fenomeno!
Make sure you leave the bell peppers out of dinner...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Lies running rampant! Utter confusion all around!
Th-this is un-ac-cep-ta-bleeee!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO!
Are you trying to lead the children down the path of evil!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Kh, there's no way an outlaw like you should be the only one children look up to!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh!! Boss, my apologies!
I have no time to be moping around!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Wait right there, Golshi-san!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I won't let you become the sole, uncontested favorite Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I'm definitely not going to let you be the only one everyone looks up to!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Even if my running lacks flash, even if I'm not popular!
—At the very least, I'll climb to the very top in standing!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: The one who will become the Derby Umamusume—is this officer!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno points her finger and makes her declaration.
Her expression was brimming with determination.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm? Gold Ship-san?
About the rest of the interview—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the thing where we announce the next race entry?
Haha. Ah, let's see...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The Derby sounds way more fun after all.
